description: Minister of Buddhasasana Religious and Cultural Affairs - Post Office Ordinance Money Orders Issued with effect from. 01.01.2021 to 31.12.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification contains rules and regulations regarding the validity, refund procedures, and expiration of money orders issued by the Post Office. It is made under statutory authority (Post Office Ordinance) and establishes legal procedures for handling lapsed money orders, making it a Legal/Regulatory gazette (Type 5). While a minister is named at the end, this is only in the capacity of issuing the regulatory notice and does not involve government personnel changes or portfolio assignments that would trigger a government-related classification.
